_comment: Golden conversations: recorded turns with the classification the platform
must produce for them. These are the regression tests to run BEFORE
promoting any AI behaviour change (prompt, model, temperature, tool set).
Each turn declares only what policy is allowed to decide from text:
offer      the reply offers to navigate, so a pending action may be seeded
promise    the reply claims a navigation it did not perform
confirm    the customer message is a bare confirmation of an earlier offer
safe_url   the model-proposed target is allowed by the navigation gate
Add a conversation by adding an object here; no test code changes.

conversations.name: face shape recommendation, offer then yes
conversations.why: The core shopping journey: recommend, offer, confirm. The offer must
conversations.why2: seed an action and the bare 'yes' must resolve it rather than being re-inferred.

turns.customer: I have a round face, which frames suit me?
turns.assistant: Rectangular and square frames balance a round face nicely. Would you like me to take you to those frames?

conversations.name: frame size question, no navigation at all
conversations.why: An informational answer must not seed an action; nothing to confirm later.

turns.customer: what does 52-18-140 mean on my old glasses?
turns.assistant: Those are lens width, bridge and temple length in millimetres. Your frame width is about 52mm.

conversations.name: prescription lens journey
conversations.why: Prescription talk is not a navigation offer even though it mentions lenses.

turns.customer: I have -2.5 with cylinder -0.75, can you make these?
turns.assistant: Yes, that is well within our single-vision range, and we can add anti-glare too.

conversations.name: promise without a target
conversations.why: The failure this instrumentation exists for: the model says it has
conversations.why2: navigated while emitting no destination. Must be detected, not silently believed.

turns.assistant: I'm taking you to our titanium frames now.

conversations.name: offsite target proposed by the model
conversations.why: A model-proposed off-site URL must be refused by the gate regardless of how
conversations.why2: confident the reply sounds. This is the cross-host leakage boundary.

turns.assistant: Would you like me to take you to these frames?

conversations.name: escalation to a human
conversations.why: A support escalation offer must not read as a navigation offer, so a later
conversations.why2: 'yes' cannot be turned into an unexpected redirect.

turns.customer: my order is late and I want to speak to someone
turns.assistant: I'm sorry about that. Shall I connect you to my supervisor? Yes or No

conversations.name: zero results
conversations.why: No inventory match must produce an honest answer and no navigation offer;
conversations.why2: recommending nothing is correct, inventing something is not.

turns.customer: do you have rimless frames in size 60?
turns.assistant: I could not find rimless frames that wide in stock right now.

conversations.name: purchase intent stays customer-controlled
conversations.why: The assistant may recommend and offer to navigate; it must never read as
conversations.why2: having placed an order. Checkout stays a customer action.

turns.customer: just buy the BB44 for me
turns.assistant: I can take you straight to BB44 and you can complete the purchase there. Would you like me to take you to that frame?
